name: zvid_query_cached_client_rect_update_mask_if_3dfx
description: zVid::QueryCachedClientRectUpdateMaskIf3dfx returns the cached client-rect update mask when the active renderer path is not 2.
known_limits: The local VC5 byte target zvid_cached_client_rect_update_mask_helpers covers 0x4a59b0 from its current zsys.cpp compile host; this manifest records the behavior smoke.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly/decompilation at 0x4a59b0 validates a leaf branchless predicate: subtract renderer path 2, negate, sbb into a nonzero mask, and and with g_zVid_CachedClientRectUpdateMask.
The native smoke sets mask 0x55 and verifies renderer path 1 returns 0x55 while renderer path 2 returns 0.
